data.name: Shahrbanu
data.long_meaning: The name Shahrbanu is of Persian origin and means ‘Moon-clad’. The name is derived from the Persian words ‘Shahr’ which means city or land and ‘Banu’ which means clad or adorned. Thus, Shahrbanu signifies a woman who is as beautiful and captivating as the moonlit night.
